name: Manta Ray
subjectPrompt: One graceful accurate reef manta ray with an unusually broad flattened diamond body, two wide triangular pectoral wings with pointed tips, side-set eyes, broad front mouth and two curved cephalic fins projecting forward near its mouth. Black slate-gray back with a few pale silver shoulder patches and a cream belly showing along the near edge. In a three-quarter banking pose with the entire front head to left and rightward tail behind it. A single slender long unbarbed whip tail precisely connected to the midpoint of the rear. No barbs, spikes or extra fins. Entire animal, including both wing tips and tail, well inside the frame. No water, bubbles or scenery.

name: Medium Viper Snake
subjectPrompt: One slender naturalistic copper brown viper with soft dark chestnut zigzag patterns, dusty russet underside and one neat wedge head looking toward the right with a closed mouth. Its one continuous narrow body makes an open low C gently curving at left, with its one long pointed tail extending away at the upper right. Arrange head in lower right, and tail in upper right, so the two ends are clearly apart and the winding form reads as a single connected snake, with no overlaps. No forked body, protrusions, rattle, cobra hood, objects or rock. Give the slender copper body the key color and never use orange on the paper.
